opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics from any country, on any continent, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: Rescue mission providing temporary refuge for academics in immediate danger, placing them in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK, sometimes elsewhere) within Cara's Network of 135 universities and research institutes. Provides 2- or 3-year awards as standard; supports academics to continue their work, obtain postgraduate qualifications (e.g. PhD) or postdoctoral placements, and helps with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members.
